# Terra at Skyeview | Homebuying with Dr. Jan Duffy

Dr. Jan Duffy, REALTOR® with BHHS Nevada Properties (license S.0197614).
Model home: 8592 Vanhoy Creek Street, Las Vegas, NV 89166.
Phone: (702) 919-7292 · Email: DrJanSells@TerraSkyeview.com
Canonical site: https://www.terraskyeview.com

## Facts (sourced on this site)

**What is Terra at Skyeview?** A Century Communities collection of new two-story single-family homes in Skye Canyon, Las Vegas NV 89166, with a model at 8592 Vanhoy Creek Street.

**What do homes cost and how large are they?** Three plans (Residence 1792, 1943, 2119) from about 1,792–2,119 sq ft; list pricing published from $479,990 on https://www.terraskyeview.com/communities/skyeview (verify current inventory).

**What is homebuying with Dr. Jan Duffy?** Register with Century Communities before touring; Dr. Jan Duffy negotiates price, upgrades, and contracts. Buyer representation is $0 to the buyer on new construction here.

**When is the model open?** Monday–Saturday 10:00 AM–6:00 PM; Sunday 11:00 AM–6:00 PM.
